verdict.rationale: Factory supports defining features, milestones, and success criteria before code is written (Missions) and requires approvals/tiered autonomy plus diff previews before changes are applied, which functions as a scope/contract gate prior to repository modification. However, there is no explicit role-based 'engineering-lead approval' workflow or sign-off gate documented — approvals appear to be generic user/session-level confirmations rather than a formal lead-approval-of-scope step. Missing for 10: dedicated approval/sign-off role or gate tied to an engineering-lead persona, and evidence of a formal 'contract' artifact requiring explicit approval before agent execution begins.
